baseline: FD:L1234-1288 (HttpTransport, read steps, RECV_LIMIT table, pools), FD:L1140-1149 (pending and deadlines), FD:L905 (10 s), FD:L4935 (HttpTransport options).
rule: Every request has exactly one recvLimit (from m1-draft-0.4/annex/recv-limits.json, by method), one pool, and a deadline. A reservation of recvLimit bytes is taken from the pool before sending (step 1) and released when the request settles. Equality with a limit is accepted.

sessionBound: SESSION_RECV_MAX = 10 MiB bounds the SITE_POOL reservations of one site session (FD:L1280), so one session holds at most 10 of the 32 MiB.
totals: Reserved receive memory <= SITE_POOL + TRUST_POOL + CONTENT_POOL = 32 MiB + 2 MiB + 544 KiB ~= 34.5 MiB (FD:L1286 states about 34.6 MiB), plus one stream piece per request; +1 MiB with STATE_POOL if CR-M1-01 is approved.
